_about.note: Evidence category of every GameBalance field and constant used by the Prompt 07 energy and life-support model. Categories: physics (standard science, no register id), S08 (ISS ECLSS, NASA page), fiction scaled from S09 (MOXIE on Mars; colony-size unit is fiction), S01/S02 (Mars constants), S20 (NASA BVAD Rev2 2022, crew use per crew member per day; register section 11), balance (game tuning, no source; never a NASA figure). Source ids refer to docs/source_register.md.

WATER_KG_PER_KG_O2.note: 2 H2O -> 2 H2 + O2: 36 g water gives 32 g oxygen, 1.126 kg (= L) of water per kg O2. Constant, not tuning.

HYDROGEN_PER_KG_WATER.note: 2 g hydrogen in 18 g water; hydrogen from electrolysis is vented (ledger hydrogen_vented_kg).

CO2_KG_PER_KG_O2.note: 2 CO2 -> 2 CO + O2: 88 g CO2 per 32 g O2 (ledger co2_intake_kg).

CO_KG_PER_KG_O2.note: 56 g CO vented per 32 g O2 (ledger co_vented_kg).

GAS_R.note: Gas constant 8.314 J/(mol K) for p = m / M x R x T / V.

HOURS_PER_DAY.note: 24 h: NASA per-crew-member-per-day figures become per-game-hour rates by dividing by 24 (one game hour = one hour of colony time). One sol (24.6598 h, S02) uses 1.0275 NASA days.

PLANT_CO2_KG_PER_KG_O2.note: 44 / 32: CO2 + H2O -> CH2O + O2. S20 Table 4-91 lettuce 10.70 g CO2 uptake per 7.78 g O2 agrees.

NASA_O2_KG_PER_CREW_DAY.note: 0.895 kg/CM-d oxygen consumed, S20 Table 3-31 (82 kg reference crew member, respiratory quotient 0.86, with daily exercise).

NASA_CO2_KG_PER_CREW_DAY.note: 1.085 kg/CM-d carbon dioxide load, S20 Table 3-31.

NASA_WATER_KG_PER_CREW_DAY.note: 4.48 kg/CM-d total water consumption, S20 Table 4-20 Early Planetary Base column.

NASA_FOOD_MJ_PER_CREW_DAY.note: 12.778 MJ/CM-d food energy (3,054 kcal), S20 Table 3-31.

NASA_FOOD_KG_PER_CREW_DAY.note: 1.56 kg/CM-d of food eaten at 48.7 % water, S20 section 3.3.5 notes to Table 3-31.

NASA_FOOD_DRY_KG_PER_CREW_DAY.note: 0.800 kg/CM-d food solids (dry, without packaging), S20 Table 3-31.

NASA_ISS_ECLSS_KW.note: 5.31 kW average ISS ECLSS power, S20 Table 3-2. A cross-check, not a game value.

battery_kwh_start.note: 630 kWh (was 560): 90 % of the new 700 kWh bank at arrival. Fiction 2080 battery bank.

battery_kwh_capacity.note: 700 kWh usable (was 800). Balance, sized with S20 for scale: 700 kWh usable = 1,167 kWh of lithium-ion cells used to the 60 % depth of discharge per cycle in S20 Table 3-17 (1,500 cycles), about 7.8 t of cells at 150 Wh/kg (Table 3-17: 100 to 150 Wh/kg). The arrival night load of 23.1 kW takes 285 kWh (41 %) per 12.33 h night; with no action the arrival colony runs flat on its fifth night; a careful night (8.9 kW) takes 110 kWh (16 %); a wasteful night (27.3 kW) 337 kWh runs a 40 % battery flat about 2 h before sunrise.

wastewater_l_start.note: 20 L of used water waiting at arrival. New store.

oxygen_kg_start.note: 60 kg in the oxygen reserve tanks (unchanged; now the reserve, not the cabin air).

n2_reserve_kg_start.note: 60 kg nitrogen for topping up cabin air. New store.

solar_kw_peak.note: 100 kW for all 12 trackers at noon, clean, tracking, default sky (was 60). Fiction 2080 array; not a NASA figure and not the old demo's 90/128/140 kW. For scale only: S01 gives 586.2 W/m2 of sunlight above Mars. Solar is exactly 0 kW from sunset (phase 0.75) to sunrise (phase 0.25): half a sol, 12.33 game hours (S02 sol 24.6598 h / 2, equator at equinox).

dust_tau_default.note: 0.5. Default dust in the air (optical depth). No measured dust opacity product is in the register yet (register section 10); the weather milestone will drive state.dust_tau.

dust_tau_factor.note: 0.6. Mechanism: dust in the air blocks sunlight, output x exp(-factor x tau), normalised to 1 at the default. The strength is tuning.

dust_deposit_per_sol.note: 0.02 of each panel per sol at the default sky, scaled by dust_tau / default. S18 (InSight dust losses) is SEARCH-ONLY and is not used for this number.

panel_dust_start.note: 0.45 on every panel at arrival (part of the arrival restoration).

cleaner_condition_start.note: 0: the automatic cleaner has failed at arrival.

battery_charge_efficiency.note: 0.9: energy stored = energy in x 0.9; the rest is ledgered as battery_loss_kwh.

base_load_kw.note: 4 kW control and heating (was 6). Balance; the life-support loads together (scrubber 1.5, fans 0.6, recycler 1.0, electrolyser up to 1.2 = 4.3 kW for 4 crew) are cross-checked against S20 Table 3-2: ISS ECLSS averages 5.31 kW.

zone_load_kw.note: Room lights per zone: Greenhouse 9 (grow lights, unchanged), Hangar bay 1, Dome plaza 0.8, Garden dome 0.8, Exterior 0.6, Command Room 0.4, Med Bay 0.4, Life Support 0.3, Power Room 0.3 kW (others were 2-5 kW).

critical_light_zones.note: Life Support, Power Room, Airlock, Med Bay: their lights count as base load and are shed last.

equipment_min_condition.note: Equipment below condition 0.5 does not run.

water_l_per_hour.note: 0.18667 L per active astronaut per game hour (was 0.25, balance) = S20 Table 4-20 Early Planetary Base total water consumption 4.48 kg/CM-d (drinking 2.00, food rehydration 0.50, urinal flush 0.50, personal hygiene 0.40, hand wash 1.08) / 24 h; 1 kg of water = 1 L. One sol uses 4.48 x 24.6598 / 24 = 4.60 L.

water_to_wastewater.note: 0.85 (unchanged, now NASA-derived): S20 Table 4-21 ISS column total wastewater 3.77 kg/CM-d for 4.45 kg/CM-d of water in (Table 4-20 ISS 3.20 + Table 3-31 water in food 0.76 + metabolic water 0.49) = 0.847. The rest leaves in breath, sweat and solid waste.

water_reserve_l.note: 100 L protected for drinking; allocations never take the store below it.

recycler_l_per_hour.note: 3 L of wastewater cleaned per game hour. The life_support area level's recycler_factor multiplies it.

recycler_recovery.note: 0.90: ISS water recovery 'about 90 percent' (NASA ECLSS page). ISS evidence, not Mars evidence.

recycler_good_condition.note: Below condition 0.8 the recycler makes water of quality condition / 0.8.

electrolyser_min_quality.note: The electrolyser stops below water quality 0.9.

wastewater_warn_fraction.note: Warn at 80 % of the wastewater tank.

electrolysis_o2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.2 kg O2 per game hour (4.8 kg per day, 4 crew need 3.58 kg per day by S20). Mechanism from S08 (oxygen generation by electrolysis of water); the rate is tuning. The life_support area level's o2_production_factor multiplies it.

electrolysis_kwh_per_kg_o2.note: 6 kWh per kg O2, above the physics minimum of about 4.1 kWh/kg (water splitting energy). Tuning.

co2_unit_o2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.15 kg O2 per game hour, about 12.5 x MOXIE's best 12 g/h. MOXIE showed the mechanism on Mars; a colony-size unit is fiction. The life_support area level's o2_production_factor multiplies it.

co2_unit_kwh_per_kg_o2.note: 20 kWh per kg O2. Not from S09 (the register holds no MOXIE power figure). Chosen higher than electrolysis: no water, more power.

cabin_volume_m3.note: 400 m3, one pressurised volume for the habitat (fiction).

o2_setpoint_kpa.note: 21 kPa, Earth-like cabin (about 109.6 kg O2 in 400 m3 at 295 K by the ideal gas law).

regulator_kg_per_hour.note: Most O2 or N2 the regulator releases per game hour, each gas: 3 kg.

scrubber_co2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.4 kg CO2 per game hour with the fans running. Mechanism from S08 (CO2 removed with molecular sieves); the rate is tuning, 2.2 times what 4 crew breathe out (4 x 0.0452 kg/h, S20). The life_support area level's scrubber_factor multiplies it.

scrubber_floor_kpa.note: The scrubber does not pull CO2 below 0.1 kPa.

fans_off_scrubber_share.note: Without the cabin fans the scrubber works at 25 %.

co2_danger_kpa.note: 1.0 kPa: above it CO2 harms the crew.

o2_low_kpa.note: 16 kPa: below it low oxygen harms the crew.

airlock_cycle_loss_kg.note: 2 kg of cabin air lost per airlock cycle, mixed in proportion.

oxygen_kg_per_hour.note: 0.037292 kg O2 per active astronaut per game hour (was 0.035, balance) = S20 Table 3-31 oxygen consumed 0.895 kg/CM-d / 24 h. Breathed from cabin air indoors and from the suit tank outside (LifeSupportModel.run_suit), never both: ColonySim counts only crew inside for the cabin.

co2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.045208 kg CO2 per active astronaut per game hour (was 0.042, balance) = S20 Table 3-31 carbon dioxide load 1.085 kg/CM-d / 24 h.

meals_per_sol.note: 3 (unchanged). A meal is a game unit; what it holds is NASA: 3 meals per sol = S20 Table 3-31 food energy 12.778 MJ/CM-d and 1.56 kg/CM-d eaten, times 24.6598 / 24 per sol, so one meal = 4.376 MJ (1,046 kcal) and 0.534 kg (GameBalance.meal_mj / meal_kcal / meal_kg). The per-hour rate is exactly the NASA per-day value / 24.

suit_o2_capacity_kg.note: 0.4 kg tank: about 11.4 game hours outside at 0.035 kg/h.

health_loss_per_hour_low_o2.note: Up to 40 health per game hour, scaled by how far cabin O2 is below o2_low_kpa (replaces health_loss_per_hour_no_oxygen).

health_loss_per_hour_co2.note: Up to 20 per game hour, scaled by how far CO2 is above co2_danger_kpa.

health_loss_per_hour_no_air.note: Legacy pure-ColonySim fallback of 25 per game hour. Production SessionService delegates atmospheric danger to its real-second exposure rule; this number is not physiological evidence.

health_loss_per_hour_no_water.note: 6 per game hour, scaled by the unmet share (unchanged).

health_loss_per_hour_no_food.note: 3 per game hour, scaled by the unmet share (unchanged).

maintenance_enabled.note: Enables the one host-owned operational wear ticker. No room, panel or client advances wear.

maintenance_wear_per_second.note: Condition lost per unpaused REAL second, default 1/480. Full condition reaches warning at 120 seconds and fault at 240 seconds before repair grace. A playtest target, not a NASA hardware lifetime.

maintenance_warning_condition.note: Default warning condition 0.75; game tuning independent of mission milestones.

maintenance_fault_condition.note: Default maintenance fault condition 0.5. One fault generation is created until repaired; this is game tuning.

maintenance_repair_seconds.note: Default host-validated maintenance job lasts 20 unpaused REAL seconds. It restores mapped condition and does not complete a room minigame.

maintenance_repair_cooldown_seconds.note: Default 15 REAL seconds of repair grace before wear resumes. Remaining grace persists through saves; no offline wear.

cleaner_wear_per_second.note: Default 1/480 condition per REAL second for the already-repairable legacy panel cleaner. Other legacy units are not assigned unrepairable faults; the existing game-hour panel-dust ticker is unchanged.

_removed.note: Removed placeholder fields: water_recycle_fraction, oxygen_kg_per_hour_generated, oxygen_generation_kw, health_loss_per_hour_no_oxygen (replaced by the recycler, the two oxygen processes and health_loss_per_hour_low_o2). SOL_HOURS (S02) and MARS_GRAVITY (S01) stay in GameConfig.
